bound_sources.evidence: Recurrence was reduced when horses wore a mask with greater than 90% UV light protection postoperatively. The discussion states that squamous cell carcinoma is a UV light-induced neoplasia and that protecting the horse from additional UV light exposure is an important part of preventing recurrence.
bound_sources.source_title: AAEP Proceedings – UV protection with masks after eyelid SCC treatment
